rows.en: I see… So they'll handle that kaiju?
Let's look for Jimmy Kitahara!
Kaiju sighted! Commencing attack!
Right, take it carefully!

I'll take it down in one shot!

All right, firing X Shell!
Wait! Stick to the plan! Fire once we've gotten closer!!
Fine…
Damn…
Don't fire yet! Get closer first!!
What's one or two kaiju! I can attack just fine from here! Firing X Shell!!
Minami, Go… Did it work?
It hit, but the X Shell's a dud!
What!? What about the kaiju?
It's nowhere to be seen!! It seems to have fled to the sea floor.
The kaiju must still be somewhere around there! We'll think of something… For now, return to base!
Yes, sir…
That's ridiculous!? The X Shell didn't explode? It checked out perfectly yesterday!

Kishida! Don't get so worked up…

Go, can you think of anything that might have caused the dud?
I have no idea…
I see…
Captain! It's ready!
Good…
What is it?

It's MAT Arrow 1's black box. It recorded the situation at that time. We might learn something!

Start it up!
All checks on Arrow 1's firing system come up perfect. No abnormalities found!
Wait… What's this record?

What the…!?

He pressed the timer, not the X Shell firing button! The X Shell isn't a dud!
No… I made a mistake…?
Either way, that kaiju's going to blow up in 10 hours!
Lucky you, Go… In 10 hours, that thing's taking the express to heaven!
Don't talk nonsense! Think things through carefully! What if the kaiju comes out into the city?
Two or three buildings would be blown away, easy… Go, how do you plan to clean up this mess?
I'm sorry…
I don't think an apology settles this… Responsibility is responsibility!

I was riding with him!

It was me… Go fired because I told him to! It's my fault he hit the wrong button too!
But…

You keep quiet!

Captain… it's all my mistake! Punish only me…

That won't do…

As it happens, right after that, I listened to the black box's voice recorder!

When Mr. Sakata allowed you to join… to be honest, I was thanking the heavens. That's how much I wanted you!

But… it seems my judgment was mistaken.

You ignored the plan and acted on your own! Accordingly, I'm ordering you confined to your home for three days!

Captain…

Go was rattled on his first sortie! Isn't that a mistake anyone could make?

What Go did wasn't a mistake! It was selfish arrogance!

That carelessness led him to disobey orders and let the kaiju get away… He wasn't taking it seriously enough!
The Captain has made his decision… Go just needs to obey it!
Go!
Leave him be!
But, Captain!
Captain! Another kaiju has appeared!

…!?

Captain, it's not the kaiju from before! It's two other kaiju!

What!?

Right… Don't let them get any closer to the city! Officer Oka! Issue an emergency evacuation advisory to local residents!
Yes, sir!

I've got it!

Jimmy Kitahara is a mutant who was exposed to huge amounts of cosmic rays! He can break his body down into atoms and make himself invisible!

The reason they're after him… is to study how that works!
The kaiju have started attacking the city!!
Right, I'll hit them with an X Shell!!

Wait!?

The X Shell's too powerful! The residents might not have finished evacuating yet!

Then are you saying we should let the kaiju get away, like Go did!?

From what I can see, there's nobody… And besides, an evacuation advisory has been issued! There can't be anyone here!

No, but… on the ground, the UCMA Special Unit is fighting the space crime organizations!

The X Shell is still too…

…!?

Go!!

Stop the attack!

I saw a little girl! The residents haven't completely finished evacuating yet!

You're supposed to be confined at home… Why are you here!?

A girl!? Don't lie!! There's nobody anywhere! You're in the way of the attack! Move!

I won't move!

Until I've rescued that girl safely, I'm not leaving this spot! She's still somewhere near here…
Uwaaagh…

Go!?

Damn… The kaiju have vanished too!
Go has it in for me! Ever since the X Shell firing blunder… he's been waiting for a chance to get back at me!
That's not true! I really did see a girl.

I believe Go!

Sure… it's a shame the kaiju got away, but I think what Go did was right, too.

You can't gloss over this with pretty words like that!

Go neglected his duty as a MAT member out of personal resentment toward me!

Captain, if things like today happen on the front line, we won't be able to carry out our missions promptly in the future!
Hey, Kishida! You don't have to go that far…
No… And besides, Go is supposed to be confined! It's better to settle this clearly!

I don't mind being punished!

But I think Officer Kishida's decision to use the X Shell there was wrong, and I'm still sure I saw a girl who didn't evacuate in time.
Why, you…

Kishida!

Go, today you…

…!?

Director Yamaoka!!
What's going on? I hear you've let the kaiju escape twice? How can you call yourself MAT's captain?

Director! Captain Kato is the finest captain MAT could have, a man worthy of respect!

Please take back what you just said to insult him!
How dare you take that attitude with the Director!
Director!
Minami! That's enough…
But…
